colony.speaker: ashfound_marshal
colony.text: Your skin is moving. The Ashfound burn things whose skin moves. Hold still and tell me why I should not.

choices.text: [Swarmborn] Because I am the one carrying your Key, Hesk. Look away.

report.speaker: ashfound_marshal
report.text: Burned, and it stayed burned; I had a watcher. Good. The Marshal wants the next thing: a Key, the Choir's own, under the Null Cathedral's fringe where the fonts go quiet. Burn what sings around it; bring the Key out cold.

choices.text: [Trueborn] Unaltered, Hesk. The one kind of person your fire is for. Cold. Understood.
[Swarmborn] (Your skin holds. Hesk sees a person, and a torch.) Cold. Understood.
Sera. The Ninth Stair was one of his.

sera_asks.speaker: sera
sera_asks.text: It was a schoolroom, Hesk. Who marked it?

hesk_answers.speaker: ashfound_marshal
hesk_answers.text: The Marshal marked it. I forged the charges. Ask me if I would again.

hesk_would.speaker: ashfound_marshal
hesk_would.text: No. Now go and get the Key before I forget I said that.

done.speaker: ashfound_marshal
done.text: The Cathedral's fringe. Bring it out cold.

early.speaker: ashfound_marshal
early.text: The shrine first. I have a watcher on it.

idle.speaker: ashfound_marshal
idle.text: Forge is hot. Say what you want.
